Real TuxGuitar files, from the TuxGuitar project (LGPL 2.1), https://github.com/helge17/tuxguitar:

- `reference_15.tg`: `common/TuxGuitar-compat/src/test/resources`, the binary 1.5 format
- `reference_20.tg`: `common/TuxGuitar-lib/src/test/resources`, the current zip and XML format, same song
- `demo_20.tg`: `misc/tuxguitar.tg`
- `drums_handmade.tg`: written by hand for this repo, because none of TuxGuitar's samples has drum notes. So it shows the player reads what the format says, not that real files look like this.
- `endings_handmade.tg`: written by hand for this repo: a repeat with endings "1. 3.", "2." and "4.", each close sign counting one repeat, the way TuxGuitar writes them. TuxGuitar plays it four times through, ten bars in all.
